evals.prompt: can you check evals/files/launch-post.md for AI tells before I send it to marketing? don't change the file yet, just tell me what's wrong
evals.expected_output: A ranked report with merged Vale findings and judgment-pass findings (unsourced 73.6% statistic, quote attributed to a named CFO with no source, false balance in pricing, repeated bold-label formula). The file is not modified.
assertions: The input file launch-post.md is unchanged (user said don't change it yet)
Flags the 73.6% statistic as unsourced or more precise than the data supports
Flags the Dana Ortiz / Acme Corp quote as needing a source or sign-off
Flags the pricing section as false balance (two options, no recommendation)
Flags the repeated bold-label formula that restates the headings
Each wording finding cites a line number, so the writer can find it
Overlapping hits on the same span are merged into one entry, not listed twice
Lists at least one hit it judged fine in context, with a reason (shows the hits were weighed, not just echoed)
Writes no rewrite of the post and invents no replacement facts (no made-up statistic, quote, or price)
Names the facts the writer must supply before the post can ship (source for 73.6%, quote sign-off, plan details)
